# Need Drop Taxi

> Reliable and affordable taxi services in Chennai and across Tamil Nadu. One-way outstation drops, local city rentals, and airport transfers with professional drivers, transparent pricing, and 24/7 availability.

## Company Information
- **Name:** Need Drop Taxi
- **Website:** https://needdroptaxi.com
- **Phone:** +91 8122211865
- **Email:** contact@needdroptaxi.com
- **Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Founded:** 2020
- **Services:** Outstation Taxi, Local Rental, Airport Transfer

## Services Offered

### Outstation Taxi Service
One-way and round-trip outstation cab services across Tamil Nadu and South India. Flat-rate pricing starting at ₹13/km for sedans. No hidden charges, toll included in estimates.
- URL: https://needdroptaxi.com/outstation-taxi-service/

### Local Rental Taxi Service
Hourly rental cabs within Chennai city limits. Available as 4-hour, 8-hour, and 12-hour packages. Starting from ₹1,350 for 4 hours / 40 km.
- URL: https://needdroptaxi.com/local-rental-taxi-service/

### Airport Transfer Service
Punctual airport pickup and drop services for Chennai International Airport (MAA). Flight tracking, meet-and-greet, and 24/7 availability. Starting from ₹14/km.
- URL: https://needdroptaxi.com/airport-transfer-taxi-service/

## Vehicle Types
- **Hatchback:** Swift, WagonR — Budget-friendly, ideal for solo/duo travelers
- **Sedan:** Dzire, Etios — Most popular, comfortable for families up to 4
- **SUV:** Innova, Ertiga — Spacious, ideal for groups of 5-7 passengers
